cost_note: Built to stay inside the configured Google Places quota, Gemini free tier, GitHub Actions, and GitHub Pages. Budget alerts remain the final safety net.

roadmap.title: Deal detail accuracy
roadmap.detail: Keep improving exact prices, discounts, schedules, and per-offer source links when restaurant sites split details across pages or images.

roadmap.title: Source coverage
roadmap.detail: Find more specials hidden in JavaScript pages, PDFs, images, sitemaps, and secondary menu pages without increasing the paid-service footprint.

roadmap.title: Logo quality
roadmap.detail: Improve brand-mark selection and contrast handling, reuse chain assets, and reject utility icons or unrelated page artwork more reliably.

roadmap.title: Report resolution
roadmap.detail: Automatically close a visitor report only after its correction is verified and visible in the published feed; ambiguous reports stay open for review.

roadmap.title: Freshness confidence
roadmap.detail: Show stronger confidence cues for recently verified, changed, and potentially expired offers without adding noisy timestamps to every row.

roadmap.title: Map refinement
roadmap.detail: Polish clustering, selected-place context, and dark-mode legibility as coverage expands into denser neighboring cities.
